basic_info.description: Discover the timeless appeal of 22 Temple Street, a delightful 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom Marina-style residence perfectly situated on a tranquil and highly sought-after street in Corona Heights. Cozy up by the wood-burning fireplace featuring gorgeous Batchelder-style tile work in the formal living room, which also offers lovely views of downtown and the Bay. The kitchen, a formal dining room, a full bathroom, and two bedrooms are also conveniently located on the main living floor. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living with a deck off the eat-in kitchen, complete with a sunny breakfast nook and butler's pantry. Climb to the primary retreat on the second floor boasting an ensuite bathroom, walk-in closet, and views of serene treetops and twinkling city lights. A unique bonus: direct flat roof access from the primary suite presents exciting potential for future build-out. The expansive 2-4 car garage offers a bonus lounge/office, a carpenter's workbench, and generous storage, with access to a zen garden oasis also available through a first floor bedroom. This is Corona Heights living at its finest.
